rows.label: tlk42200241_02_msg0001
rows.name:
Harula became an Invidian citizen
just to see the Safroge Tree every
day, mo.

rows.label: tlk42200241_02_msg0002
rows.name:
But... Invidia has many rough types,
and status as a noble or mercenary
really matters, mo.

rows.label: tlk42200241_02_msg0003
rows.name:
After living here, Harula realized
it wasn't a very comfortable city, mo.

rows.label: tlk42200241_02_msg0004
rows.name:
I think I want to move to the
more sophisticated Superbia, mo.

rows.label: tlk42200241_02_msg0005
rows.name:
But since I've already become
an Invidian citizen, I can't
get permission... mo.

rows.label: tlk42200241_02_msg0006
rows.name:
The Empire will treat me as
a spy no matter what... mo.
